name: services/blobbox/users
description: Get storage usage statistics grouped by users. Note, that user stats do not include blobs uploaded by other consumers! You have access only to stats related to your application.
brief_description: Get storage usage statistics for given users.

arguments.name: user_ids
arguments.description: Pipe-separated list of user IDs (no more than 500).

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Pipe-separated list of fields (as in the consumer method).

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary. User IDs will be mapped to keys of this dictionary. Each value will be a dictionary of the same structure as the one returned in the consumer method. However, all the values will be computed against blobs uploaded by matched users only.

For all invalid references (unknown user IDs), the value will be null.
